model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  Attitude =~ att_appealing + att_desirable +
              att_goodidea + att_pleasant
  PBC =~ pbc_barrier + pbc_could +
         pbc_resources
  DescriptiveNorms =~ norms_d_many + norms_d_common +
                      norms_d_few
  InjunctiveNorms =~ norms_i_consider + norms_i_bad +
                     norms_i_support


  Symbolism =~ symb_envresp + symb_modern
  AoC =~ aoc_transport + aoc_overstated + aoc_minor
  BEnv =~ ben_env_reduce + ben_env_shift + ben_env_nodiff
  
  Reactance =~ reactance_interfere + reactance_rulesharm + reactance_commongood + reactance_individual
  AntiIntel =~ antiintel_commonsense + antiintel_facts + antiintel_expertshelp

  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev


  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  Intention ~ d1*Attitude + PBC + d2*InjunctiveNorms + DescriptiveNorms  
  Attitude ~ c1*AoC + b1*BEnv + Symbolism + f1*Reactance + e1*AntiIntel
  BEnv ~ a*AoC
  AoC ~ g*AntiIntel
  InjunctiveNorms ~  Symbolism

  
  # AoC on Attitude
  dir_aoc_att := c1
  ind_aoc_att := a*b1
  tot_aoc_att := c1 + a*b1

  # AoC on Intention
  ind_tot_aoc_int := a*b1*d1 + c1*d1
  
  # Dispositions on Attitude and Intention
  dir_tot_pr_att := f1
  
  ind_tot_pr_int := f1*d1
  
  dir_ai_att := e1
  ind_ai_aoc_att := g*c1
  ind_ai_aoc_benv_att := g*a*b1
  ind_ai_att := g*c1 + g*a*b1
  tto_ai_att := e1 + g*c1 + g*a*b1
  
  ind_tot_ai_int := (e1 + g*c1 + g*a*b1)*d1 

  # =======================================
  # Covariance path
  # ======================================= 
  Attitude ~~ PBC
  Attitude ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  Attitude ~~ InjunctiveNorms
  
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ PBC
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ AoC
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ BEnv
  
  BEnv ~~ PBC
  BEnv ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  BEnv ~~ Symbolism
  
  # New endo ~~ exo paths in the presence of dispositional accounts (same as 2.2.1a)
  BEnv ~~ Reactance

  InjunctiveNorms ~~ Reactance
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ AntiIntel
  
  # New endo ~~ exo paths due to AoC becoming an endo compared to 2.2.1a
  AoC ~~ PBC
  AoC ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  AoC ~~ Symbolism
  AoC ~~ Reactance
  
  # In addition, all exo ~~ exo allowed with auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE
